PLAN "PCOS Strength & Metabolic Health — 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lean mass and improve insulin sensitivity via progressive resistance training"
  GOAL secondary body_composition:
    name "Improve body composition without caloric restriction stress"
  GOAL tertiary metabolic:
    name "Support HPA axis regulation through structured, recoverable training load"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation — Movement Quality and Baseline Load" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body — Hinge and Quad Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          child_pose 1m

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body — Push and Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body — Compound Primer":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
